ipadp_role.description: Sits between the upstream Firebird C/C++ client library (FirebirdSQL/firebird releases) and downstream doctrine-firebird-driver. Translates the Firebird OO API (IProvider/IAttachment/ITransaction) into PHP procedural (fbird_*) and OOP (Firebird\*) layers.

connects.interface: C/C++ client library (libfbclient), OO API headers (Interface.h, IdlFbInterfaces.h)
fbird_* procedural functions + Firebird\ OOP classes

FirebirdSQL/firebird.role: client library provider (libfbclient, OO API headers)

_private_downstream.role: Symfony entity layer (name redacted - private repo)

privacy.notes: php-firebird is a public GitHub repo. The _private_downstream consumer name is redacted to avoid exposing private GitLab project identity. No public-to-private links exist.
